item.title: Ryan Donato scores twice as the Blackhawks beat the Sharks 6-3
item.description: The Chicago Blackhawks beat the San Jose Sharks 6-3 on Monday night, with Ryan Donato scoring two goals and two assists, and Connor Bedard scoring his third consecutive goal.

item.title: No decision on Harvey's interim mayor at first meeting since Christopher Clark's death
item.description: No candidate received the four votes needed to be named acting mayor of Harvey during a city council meeting Monday night, following the unexpected death of Mayor Christopher Clark.
